description: Shortlist active policies of one type by what their documents say, e.g. health cover with a pre-existing disease wait of at most 24 months and lifelong renewal, or 60+ days of pre-hospitalisation. Conditions are on the category's bool, duration and number fields (keys and units from list_categories with category; a bad key returns the allowed list). Only products that state each value are returned, each with the matching values and policy paras. Nothing is ranked: compare the shortlist with compare_policies.

value.description: In the field's unit (days, months...); for yes/no fields true or false

name: find_policies
